newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha holds ground on trader bidding.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha holds ground on trader bidding.

text.p: NWE naphtha resisted crude's decline amid healthy bidding on the swaps market and continued tight supply, traders said.

October swaps were talked at a robust $206.50 cif NWE in late trading. Petrochemical demand remains good. Propane and butane are talked at around $250 a tonne cif NWE and would need to fall by over $60 to become more attractive than naphtha as a feedstock, dealers said. But little product was seen available to cater for this demand. One dealer said he thought paraffinic prices were worth around $2 over full-range.
